run_llm_callback: run the llm_callback to call a language model on the current prompt prefix with configurable samples and space healing
run_generate_text: run generate_text to produce a single text completion from the current prompt prefix with temperature and stop options
run_generate_texts: run generate_texts to produce multiple text completions from the current prompt prefix with configurable sample count
run_choose: run choose to score and select the best candidate from a list of options using log-probability ranking
run_generate_object: run generate_object to produce a typed Python object from the current prompt prefix using constrained decoding
